Name: Twin Ghost
Overview:
Twin Ghost tells the tale of two ghosts on their way to heaven. That is until they get separated en route and must now be reunited.

During gameplay, the player takes control of both ghosts using both of the thumbsticks, one thumbstick controlling one of the ghosts each, and must use the ghosts to collect all of the hearts in the game field then get both ghosts through the exit of the level together. The player must also keep an eye on both of the ghosts as they drift about when not being moved and can potentially drift into a 'reaper block' which causes the player to fail the level.
